summary: The Mosaic Company filed an 8-K announcing pricing terms for cash tender offers to purchase up to $1.4 billion aggregate principal of four series of its outstanding senior notes and debentures due 2027-2029, with a $150 million cap on the 2029 notes. The offers, launched with an Offer to Purchase dated August 10, 2026, are subject to proration and acceptance priority levels, expiring August 14, 2026. Mosaic may adjust caps. This debt repurchase is a liability management transaction, reducing leverage and interest expense. Watch for final acceptance amounts and any tender cap increases.
